_meta.note: Variant SKUs imported from Download Catalog CSV. Verify before live orders.
_meta.instructions: 1. In CustomCat dashboard, go to Create Product > Advanced Tools > Download Catalog. 2. Save the CSV. 3. Run: node scripts/import-customcat-catalog.js <path-to-csv>. 4. Verify lib/customcat-map.json has catalogSku for all variants.
